verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־ הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ הַאֲזִ֥ינָה׀ אֲמָרַ֖י יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’el- han·nə·ḥî·lō·wṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ’ă·mā·ray Yah·weh bî·nāh hă·ḡî·ḡî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster to be accompanied by flutes A Psalm of David Give ear to my words O LORD consider my groaning

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀ לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šî·ḇāh lə·qō·wl šaw·‘î mal·kî wê·lō·hāy kî- ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ·pal·lāl
verses.literal: Attend to the sound of my cry my King and my God for to You I pray

verses.original: בֹּ֭קֶר יְֽהוָ֗ה תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bō·qer Yah·weh tiš·ma‘ qō·w·lî bō·qer ’e·‘ĕ·rāḵ- lə·ḵā wa·’ă·ṣap·peh
verses.literal: In the morning O LORD You hear my voice at daybreak I lay [my plea] before You and wait in expectation

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֤א אֵֽל־ חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע׀ לֹ֖א רָֽע׃ יְגֻרְךָ֣
verses.transliteration: kî ’āt·tāh lō ’êl- ḥā·p̄êṣ re·ša‘ lō rā‘ yə·ḡur·ḵā
verses.literal: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness no evil can dwell with You

verses.original: הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wl·lîm lə·ne·ḡeḏ lō- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū ‘ê·ne·ḵā śā·nēʾ·t̲ā kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: The boastful . . . cannot stand in Your presence You hate all workers of iniquity

verses.original: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב יְהוָֽה׃ יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב׀ אִישׁ־ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: tə·’ab·bêḏ dō·ḇə·rê ḵā·zāḇ Yah·weh yə·ṯā·‘êḇ ’îš- dā·mîm ū·mir·māh
verses.literal: You destroy those who tell lies the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ הֵֽיכַל־
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·ḇō·w ḇê·ṯe·ḵā bə·rōḇ ḥas·də·ḵā bə·yir·’ā·ṯe·ḵā ’eš·ta·ḥă·weh ’el- qāḏ·šə·ḵā hê·ḵal-
verses.literal: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple

verses.original: נְחֵ֬נִי יְהוָ֤ה׀ בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הוֹשַׁר דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃ לְפָנַ֣י
verses.transliteration: nə·ḥê·nî Yah·weh ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ma·‘an šō·wr·rāy hō·šar dar·ke·ḵā lə·p̄ā·nay
verses.literal: Lead me O LORD in Your righteousness because of my enemies make straight Your way before me

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קִרְבָּ֪ם גְּרוֹנָ֑ם פָּת֥וּחַ קֶֽבֶר־ לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên bə·p̄î·hū nə·ḵō·w·nāh haw·wō·wṯ qir·bām gə·rō·w·nām pā·ṯū·aḥ qe·ḇer- lə·šō·w·nām ya·ḥă·lî·qūn
verses.literal: For not a word they speak can be trusted destruction [lies] within them Their throats are open graves their tongues practice deceit

verses.original: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי־ מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·šî·mêm ’ĕlō·hîm yip·pə·lū mim·mō·‘ă·ṣō·w·ṯê·hem had·dî·ḥê·mōw bə·rōḇ piš·‘ê·hem kî- mā·rū ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Declare them guilty O God let them fall by their own devices Drive them out for their many transgressions for they have rebelled against You

verses.original: כָל־ ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ לְעוֹלָ֣ם וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗
verses.transliteration: ḵāl ḥō·w·sê ḇāḵ wə·yiś·mə·ḥū yə·ran·nê·nū lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·ṯā·sêḵ ‘ā·lê·mōw ’ō·hă·ḇê šə·me·ḵā wə·ya‘·lə·ṣū ḇə·ḵā
verses.literal: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice let them ever shout for joy . . . May You shelter them that those who love Your name may rejoice in You

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּה֮ יְהוָ֑ה תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃ כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh tə·ḇā·rêḵ ṣad·dîq ta‘·ṭə·ren·nū kaṣ·ṣin·nāh rā·ṣō·wn
verses.literal: For surely You O LORD bless the righteous You surround them with the shield of Your favor
